payload.title: Controlled PF-E004 fusion
payload.statement: Cross-fitted placement of PF path evidence with the deployment-ready E004 geometry-prefix candidate can retain PF diversity and tail reduction while avoiding the standalone PF subgroup and p90 regressions.
payload.evidence_for: E006 strictly nested fusion selects nested_conservative_grid at 14.9331407872 RMSE, a 0.5581656110 gain over E004, with 5/5 map wins, 25/25 outer-cell wins, lower p90 and worst-tail concentration, positive every spatial/typewell group, and exact private Kaggle byte parity.
payload.evidence_against: The improvement remains far from the archived competitive score bands, hidden test contains roughly 200 wells, and the deployment model uses a globally refit 0.5 PF weight rather than a learned per-well route.
payload.next_test: Retain E006 as the deployment-ready primary surface-free family and pre-register E007/H005 horizontal self-correlation as an independent candidate with template-shuffle, repeated-fold, tail, subgroup, runtime, and residual-correlation controls.
